form:FormGroup.label: Protocol
form:FormGroup.helpText: The TLS protocol used to create the secure connection, e.g. TLSv1.2. Default is TLSv1.3.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: TLS protocol name. Default is TLSv1.3.

form:FormGroup.label: Provider
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the Java security provider to use for TLS, e.g. SunJSSE. Leave blank to use the Java default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank for the Java default.

form:FormGroup.label: Key Store
form:FormGroup.helpText: Key store credentials holding the client certificate and private key, for servers that require a client certificate. Leave blank if none is needed.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Client certificate for mutual TLS. Leave blank if not needed.

form:FormGroup.label: Trust Store
form:FormGroup.helpText: Key store credentials holding the certificates used to trust the server. Leave blank to use the Java default trust store.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank for the Java default trust store.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Trust a server certificate that is self-signed (one with no issuing certificate authority), even if it is not in the Trust Store. Other certificates must still be trusted by the Trust Store. Default is not ticked.
Check that the host name in the server's certificate matches the host being connected to. Untick only for testing, as it makes the connection less secure. Default is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Supported Protocols
form:FormGroup.helpText: The TLS protocol versions that may be used, one per line, e.g. TLSv1.2. Leave blank to allow the Java defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One per line, e.g. TLSv1.2. Blank allows Java defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Supported Ciphers
form:FormGroup.helpText: The cipher suites that may be used, one per line, e.g. TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384. Leave blank to allow the Java defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One per line. Blank allows Java defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Certificate Alias
form:FormGroup.helpText: The alias of the client certificate to use when the key store holds more than one. Leave blank to choose automatically.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Needed only if the key store has several certificates.
